pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Proxmox VE High Availability Manager. Provides watchdog-mux (C daemon that multiplexes /dev/watchdog), pve-ha-crm (Cluster Resource Manager — one elected master per cluster), pve-ha-lrm (Local Resource Manager — one per node), ha-manager CLI, REST API endpoints (/nodes/{n}/ha/*), and HA notification templates.
Source: upstream proxmox.com 5.2.4. pxvirt 5.0.4 has no pxvirt-specific changes — just 2 minor versions behind. Upstream adds: disarm mode (graceful maintenance without fencing), watchdog safety improvements, updated service config API, and syslog-compatible log levels.
HA is OPTIONAL — pvedaemon runs on single nodes without it. Install only on multi-node cluster nodes where VM failover is required.
CONFIG_CHECK: requires CONFIG_WATCHDOG in kernel. softdog module works if no hardware watchdog is present.
